name: Four Seasons Hotel Miami
insider_take: Where luxury meets the vibrant pulse of Biscayne Bay – this is Miami sophistication at its finest.
whats_special: The Four Seasons Hotel Miami occupies floors 7-39 of a stunning 64-story tower, offering unparalleled panoramic views of Biscayne Bay and the Atlantic Ocean. The hotel features a unique three-pool experience including an adults-only rooftop pool on the 7th floor, making it one of Miami's most coveted sky-high retreats. Chef Ryan Ratino's BRASA brings Michelin-starred dining to the 8th floor with innovative South American cuisine.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on higher floors for spectacular sunrise views over Key Biscayne, and time your rooftop pool visit for golden hour – the city skyline transforms into pure magic.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime Brickell Avenue location puts you steps from the Miami River and a 10-minute drive to South Beach. Take advantage of the complimentary house car service within a 2-mile radius, perfect for exploring the trendy Design District or catching a Miami Heat game at nearby FTX Arena.
pros: Prime Brickell Avenue location with stunning bay and city views
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Exceptional dining options including rooftop restaurants
Luxurious spa and fitness facilities with panoramic views
cons: Urban downtown location rather than beachfront
